summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting Amendment No. 1 to its $25.03 million convertible promissory note issued August 18, 2026 to Streeterville Capital, LLC. The amendment sets a floor price of $0.0632, equal to 20% of the Nasdaq Minimum Price before issuance, and prevents fixed-price adjustments from falling below that floor. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. This is a routine note amendment, not a special situation; watch dilution and conversion pricing risk.
